title: LibriSpeech-Real-QA: A Benchmark for Streaming Question Answering
abstract: arXiv:2611.06496v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Most speech large language models (SLMs) still process speech in an offline manner. They only start responding after they receive the complete speech segment. However, many real-world applications require streaming speech interaction, for which the audio continuously flows in and the machine is required to answer questions based on the so far received audio chunks. For example, a user may ask the system to continuously count how many times a person's name has been mentioned while they are speaking. We observe a lack of benchmarks and evaluation protocols for real-time speech interaction. Motivated by this, we propose LibriSpeech-Real-QA, a dataset and a benchmark for real-time speech interaction. translated_abstract: 大多数语音大语言模型（SLMs）仍然以离线方式处理语音，只有在接收到完整的语音片段后才开始响应。然而，许多现实世界的应用需要流式语音交互，即音频持续流入，机器需要根据迄今为止接收到的音频块来回答问题。例如，用户可能要求系统在某个人说话的过程中持续统计其名字被提及的次数。我们观察到目前缺乏针对实时语音交互的基准测试和评估协议。受此启发，我们提出了LibriSpeech-Real-QA，一个用于实时语音交互的数据集和基准。我们从LibriSpeech构建了不同类型的实时问答对，以评估语音大语言模型能否在流式音频中识别目标词。我们评估了几种流行的实时商业模型，发现它们仍然倾向于……
tldr: 该论文提出了LibriSpeech-Real-QA，一个用于实时语音交互的基准数据集，通过从LibriSpeech构建实时问答对来评估语音大语言模型在流式音频中识别目标词的能力。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes LibriSpeech-Real-QA, a benchmark dataset for real-time speech interaction, constructed from LibriSpeech to evaluate whether speech LLMs can identify target words in streaming audio.
